facts.activity_series: maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment

control_failures.control_label: integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: potential incident - chemical exposure at TK-7103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on TK-7103 and PSV-7103 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically monitoring seal-face condition and temperature. TK-7103 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 22 June 2021 a potential incident was recorded on TK-7103 and PSV-7103 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during a planned shutdown; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
